relationship_details.response_date_policy: After April 8, 1843; the existing April 24 knowledge witness gives a composed-by bound, not an exact composition or receipt day. Preserve raw XML upper bound separately.
relationship_details.rationale: Darwin forwards Kemp seeds, requests planting and a report, and asks that results not be published. Lindley promises a report on the seeds just sent and confidentiality through his agents, then gives tentative identifications. This distinctive request-and-answer sequence supports the reverse reply. The separate 672F witness already records Darwin knowledge.
